crossRefs.note: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, That wisdom is driven quite from me?
But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
“Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

translations.web: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
translations.bsb: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!
translations.kjv: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
translations.asv: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!
